title: Phase 0: drop the unused third-party requires from go.mod
objective: Remove the four third-party modules that no product source imports (cobra, viper, fatih/color, fsnotify) from go.mod, leaving the standard-library-only dependency posture that §15.6 and §17.2 require, so the first real dependency can be introduced deliberately with a committed go.sum.
acceptance: go.mod declares no module that no product source imports
go test ./... and go vet ./... still pass after the change
go build ./cmd/fake-jev still succeeds with GOPROXY=off
the resulting go.mod contains no cobra, viper, fatih/color, or fsnotify entry
nonGoals: do not introduce any new dependency, including the YAML library FJ-010 will need
do not add go.sum entries for modules that are not imported
do not change the CI workflow
do not change any product source file
nextAction: specifier: restate §17.2/§15.6 as observable criteria, then coder trims go.mod
notes: PM 2026-09-26: opened from the FJ-004 close-out. The golang-cli skill recommends Cobra+Viper as the default stack; spec §15.6 and §17.2 forbid that, so the spec wins (authority level 1 over level 5). The CLI will use the standard library flag package.

PM 2026-09-26: no go.sum exists in the tree today. FJ-004 CI runs GOPROXY=off, so the first real import would fail closed on a missing go.sum entry. This ticket removes that trap rather than arming it.
